author: Top Gear
description:
In this video Top Gear takes a look at the new Apollo Evo hypercar, a successor to the wild Apollo Intensa Emozione. It packs a 6.3-litre V12 with 800hp, and claims more downforce than the Aston Martin Valkyrie. Is this the world’s maddest hypercar?
